column1: # Region / ocean mapping for OSRS port tasks.  EDIT ME.
# This file is the source of truth for grouping. `make data` folds it into the app.
# Columns are tab-separated; opens fine in a spreadsheet too.
#   region     landmass / kingdom. Zeah covers both Great Kourend and Varlamore.
#   subregion  optional finer grouping, blank if none.
#   oceans     pipe-separated. A port on a border may list more than one and will
#              match a filter for either (e.g. Corsair Cove).
# `make refresh-oceans` re-checks the oceans column against the wiki. It never
# overwrites your edits - it only reports differences and fills in blanks.
#   dock_level     Sailing level needed to dock here.
#   shipwright     yes = you can recover a capsized/parked boat at this port.
#   notice_board / salvaging / ledger / crew_registrar   other port amenities.
#   coords         world x,y - kept for a future map view.
# `make refresh` re-checks these against the wiki. It fills blanks and reports
# differences but never overwrites your edits unless you pass --apply.
